finding.observed: GitHub documents that List workflow runs for a repository returns up to 1,000 results for each search when actor, branch, check_suite_id, created, event, head_sha, or status filters are used.
finding.inference: A head_sha-filtered traversal cannot prove exhaustive absence or completeness when the filtered result set could reach the provider ceiling.
finding.current_decision: Use unfiltered repository workflow-run pagination as the authoritative enumeration path, filter by exact head_sha locally, and use a head_sha-filtered query only as a non-authoritative diagnostic comparator.
finding.uncertainty: GitHub does not state on the cited endpoint page that unfiltered repository pagination has the same 1,000-result search ceiling; this contract therefore requires full Link-header exhaustion and independent count consistency rather than assuming unlimited retention.

documents.title: REST API endpoints for workflow runs
relevant_claims: Filtered workflow-run searches using head_sha and other named parameters return up to 1,000 results.
head_sha restricts results to runs associated with the specified commit.

documents.title: Using pagination in the REST API
relevant_claims: REST pagination is represented through Link response headers when additional pages exist.

documents.title: gh api manual
relevant_claims: --paginate requests additional pages until pagination is exhausted.
--slurp wraps paginated JSON arrays or objects into one outer array.

steps: Validate owner, repository, and exact 40-hex commit SHA.
Request the unfiltered repository workflow-run endpoint with per_page=100.
Follow every rel=next Link until no next relation remains.
Retain raw response pages, response retrieval timestamps, status codes, and Link headers.
Reject any page with a non-200 response, malformed payload, duplicate run ID, or missing required run identity fields.
Require the sum of workflow_runs lengths to equal the retained enumerated_count.
Filter locally where run.head_sha equals the exact commit SHA.
Record all event types without excluding pull_request-associated runs.
Produce a canonical digest over ordered retained page payloads and traversal metadata.
Mark coverage complete only after Link exhaustion and all invariants pass.
authoritative_algorithm.completion_predicate: link_exhausted && all_http_200 && payloads_valid && no_duplicate_run_ids && count_consistent && raw_pages_retained && canonical_digest_present

diagnostic_comparator.purpose: Detect divergence and expose provider-ceiling risk without using the filtered result to prove exhaustive completeness.
rules: Retain every filtered page and Link header.
If the filtered set differs from the locally filtered authoritative set, reject reconciliation.
A filtered zero result cannot override a nonzero authoritative local-filter result.
Agreement does not replace authoritative Link exhaustion.

test_vectors.name: unfiltered traversal exhausted and comparator agrees
authoritative traversal stops before Link exhaustion
filtered zero conflicts with authoritative match

falsification_route: Run both traversals against a repository with more than 1,000 filtered matches for one supported filter and verify the comparator is marked ambiguous.
Compare the unfiltered local-filter set against GraphQL or a second independently implemented REST client for the same exact commit.
Inject duplicate IDs, truncated Link traversal, and count drift into retained fixtures and require rejection.
Revisit the contract if GitHub documents a universal ceiling for unfiltered workflow-run listing or changes pagination semantics.

prohibitions: Do not retain authorization headers or tokens.
Do not publish private repository run names, logs, actor identities, or artifact contents in public evidence.
Store raw private-repository responses only in approved restricted evidence storage.
